title: Ashbury Rewards Points Ledger: Night Credits of an Award Stay
content:
The elite night credits Ashbury Rewards posts for an award stay — a completed stay booked under the Reward Night Rate — rest on the definitions below.

## Definitions

**D1 — The award stay concerned.** The award stay concerned is the member's checked-out Reward Night Rate reservation attached to the membership, read from the member's Room Reservations record.

**D2 — Nights stayed.** The nights stayed on the award stay are the whole calendar days from its actual check-in date to its actual check-out date.

**D3 — Credits.** The award stay receives the tier's night credit per night stayed for each night stayed: the nights stayed multiplied by the elite night credits per night stayed in one room of the tier the membership holds.

## Worked figure (hypothetical stay)

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| Rate plan and status | Reward Night Rate, checked out |
| Actual check-in date | 2 September |
| Actual check-out date | 6 September |
| Nights stayed (D2) | 4 |
| Tier's night credit per night stayed, taken as | 1 |
| Night credits posted (D3) | 4 multiplied by 1, which is 4 |

The nights are counted from the actual dates: a guest booked for five nights who checked out a day early has four nights stayed, and four is the figure that D3 multiplies.
